listing.summary: Original Mod for Starsector by: SAVEmedley and 死萌 (Simeng)
listing.aiSummary: Adds 12 new officers and 4 administrators based on characters from the Mimikko app, each with unique skills, storylines, and rewards.

description: Introduces a roster of anime-style officers and admins who provide unique skills, quests, and rewards such as exclusive ships and weapons. Players can interact with these characters in a colony dorm to build relationships and unlock content. The mod also includes officer cap increases when specific assistants are assigned to ships.

(TL Update Mar 5-2024 v0.5)
Dependencies:
Lazy Lib/Magic Lib/Graphic Lib

There is a known issue that can break saves that can sometime be triggered by making one of Nonona’s skill elite(it will happen sometime after the skill is made elite). This does not always happen but we suggest you making multiple save to be sure. Since many assistant are seeing rework next patch that will likely fix this issue, and we aren’t able to pin point the cause, there will not be a hot fix for this issue.

Safe to add mid-save but some unique salvage are generated at sector gen and will only be available in a new game.

If playing with Nexerelin, the randomized sector option will make most assistants unobtainable (it is fine to use Nex, there is a unique start to go with it, just avoid randomized sector)
